text:
alex_support: FYI customer acme-inc opened an escalation — production traffic to their Dedicated pool is getting 429s and long queuing. They report p95 latency spikes and autoscale not reacting fast enough. I captured request headers and control-plane decision logs below. Can @eng-runtime take a look? :eyes:

jamie_sre: putting initial facts here: 429 rate_limited from inference API, tenant acme-inc, pool target `dedicated-usw-lowcap-01`. CPU/GPU metrics show GPU util ~88% when throttling hits. Autoscale triggered but scaled up after ~90-140s. Customer says SLA breach window ~2m.

li: quick repro curl we used from prod repro:```bash
curl -XPOST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Routing: tier=latency,region=us-west,tenant=acme-inc" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large","input":"hello"}'
```
Responses: many 429 with body `{"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":15}` and intermittent 503s.

maria_prod: attaching the exact control-plane decision log (sanitized) — looks like policy ordering flipped for this tenant after the last release:```text
[2026-03-15T11:02:33Z] policy_eval start tenant=acme-inc
[2026-03-15T11:02:33Z] matched rule cost_saving_rule (priority=20) -> weight=0.7
[2026-03-15T11:02:33Z] matched rule latency_sensitive_rule (priority=30) -> weight=0.9
[2026-03-15T11:02:33Z] final_score(cost)=0.72 final_score(latency)=0.88
[2026-03-15T11:02:33Z] selected_pool dedicated-usw-lowcap-01 // expected dedicated-usw-highcap-02
```
Note: latency_sensitive_rule has higher priority number but the engine is treating lower numeric as higher priority post-change. Might be inverted comparator bug.

ops-bot: Alert: dedicated-usw-lowcap-01 GPU queue_length > 250, queued_tokens 1.2M, throttle_rate increased to 60% at 11:04:05Z

alex_support: customer-provided metrics: p50=80ms, p95=3.1s (before routing change p95 ~600ms), error rate -> 12% 429s in 10m window. They hit burst >200rps and we routed to lowcap pool.

jamie_sre: quick hypothesis: control-plane comparator inversion caused requests that requested "tier=latency" to lose to cost rule, sending to lowcap pool. Autoscale policy exists but lowcap pool max replicas=2 and scale-up cooldown is 60s; slow reaction plus queueing equals throttling.

li: debug note — I saw a recent change in policy comparator: `return a.priority < b.priority` was intended but got flipped. That would invert the order.

eng-runtime: confirming — we rolled a comparator change in canary last night (PR 4521). Reproduced locally: when rules have priority 30 (latency) and 20 (cost), engine picks 20. Reverting should fix selection. Opening hotfix now.

maria_prod: customer wants immediate mitigation. Options: 1) manual override to route acme-inc -> dedicated-usw-highcap-02, 2) increase lowcap pool max_replicas to 6 temporarily, 3) rollback comparator change. Which is fastest?

eng-runtime: fastest is manual routing override for that tenant (takes <5m). We'll also push hotfix to revert comparator inversion and prepare rollback if needed.

alex_support: please run override and notify me so I can confirm with the customer. Also need postmortem notes: expected root cause (policy comparator inversion), impact (throttling/429s, p95 regressed), mitigation (override + hotfix), and follow-ups (test for comparator sign, add unit test, change autoscale cooldown for lowcap pools).

support-bot: Note created: INC-2026-0423 linked to this thread. Priority: P1.

jamie_sre: after manual override (confirmed) — routing now sends to dedicated-usw-highcap-02. Customer reports immediate drop in 429s, p95 down to ~650ms within 30s. We'll keep monitoring for 1h. :thumbsup:

eng-runtime: hotfix merged to rollback comparator, deploying to control-plane canary now, will promote to prod after 15m smoke tests.

li: follow-up items for postmortem: add regression test for priority comparator sign, add integration test that simulates burst routing for mixed-priority rules, consider dynamic bump of lowcap pool max_replicas during sudden burst as temporary safety valve.

maria_prod: I'll draft the customer-facing summary and share with legal/CS for messaging.

alex_support: thanks everyone. Recording timeline + actions in INC-2026-0423.

ops-bot: Incident status: mitigated. Monitoring.
